title: LLM call-site inventory
description: The W1 audit artefact: every place application code in engine, utils, lumic-utils or backend-legacy can reach a language model. Site objects carry exactly the authoritative Section-4 keys of docs/llm-provider-migration.md and no others, so a hand edit that invents a field fails the schema gate rather than silently entering the mapping pass.

heuristics_version.description: Version of the path-heuristic table that produced latency_class and criticality, so the W1-02 classification pass can state what it overrode.

generator.description: Repo-relative path of the producing script. A stale artefact must be traceable to the code that emitted it.

model_current.description: Vendor model literal named at this site. Null when the site names none: absence is recorded as absence rather than defaulted.

monthly_tokens.description: Zero from the scanner, which cannot observe volume. Joined from billing exports at W1-03.

alias.description: Semantic alias the site already names. Null until the W4 codemods assign one.

eval_gate.description: Assigned at W2-01; always null in the discovered seed.

registries.description: Files that hold vendor strings as data rather than as a call. Recorded with a reason so an excluded file is auditable, never silently dropped.
